summary: Merged todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T032.md from a dual-layer expression (`> Contract status: FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778` + `> Owner amendment (2026-09-16):` block) into a single unified contract body per Owner Decision 5. Removed both top markers. Folded the Owner amendment's binding wording into the Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not, and References sections, and added Decision 4's scanned-empty / failed / cancelled-skipped boundary, explicit reason-code enumeration (including `budget_exhausted`), the no local-skip-then-complete hard constraint, and the remaining-budget-bound requirement (operator injection or provider usage API, never assume unused monthly quota). Cold-start vs warm incremental ingestion, the Initialize-to-end-block scan, the suffix-only warm path, the one topic0 OR query with topic1 poolId filter, the explicit non-secret application User-Agent on Robinhood, the Alchemy-Free archive/verification role, and the per-endpoint capability + call/CU/time budget with remaining-budget bound are all preserved. The Acceptance section enumerates the fixtures the Owner named (Alchemy 10-block cap, Robinhood wide-range + adaptive split, HTTP 403 from missing/blocked User-Agent, response-size overflow, rate limiting, budget exhaustion with complete=false, provider failover without gaps) and adds kill/restart at each boundary, overlapping/concurrent-run convergence, every-requested-block-covered-exactly-once, and checkpoint rejection on manifest / block hash / schema / decode / coverage prefix mismatch. The Must-not section is expanded with the credential-URL rule, the no fixed-provider-cap assumption, the no silent cancelled-to-empty reclassification, and the no provisional-data-promotion past a failed / uncovered interval rule. A `## Binding direction reference` audit-trail subsection cites /tmp/owner_decision_T032.txt and lists Decisions 4 and 5 as the consolidated source. No implementation, attempt counter, evidence pointer, commit SHA, runtime configuration, or approval data in todo/config.yaml was changed.
rationale: The merge is required because the dual-layer contract was not directly executable: the frozen-from-baseline body and the 2026-09-16 Owner amendment block together left the Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not, and References sections out of sync, and Decision 4's provider-failover / scanned-empty / failed / cancelled boundary plus the remaining-budget-bound rule were never written into the contract body. Per Decision 5 the amendment is binding direction, not a remark, and must be merged into a single unified contract body; the Developer is forbidden from picking only one layer. The merged contract is built by (a) deleting both top markers, (b) inlining every binding instruction from the amendment into the corresponding Outcome / Deliverables / Acceptance / Must-not / References paragraphs, (c) adding Decision 4's scanned-empty / failed / cancelled-skipped distinction, explicit reason-code enumeration (with `budget_exhausted`), the no local-skip-then-complete hard constraint, and the remaining-budget-bound requirement into the same paragraphs, and (d) keeping a `## Binding direction reference` audit-trail subsection that cites /tmp/owner_decision_T032.txt so future contract edits update the body, not this subsection. This matches the parallel T030 (now APPROVED via 9a44378 / 870c07d) and T031 (now APPROVED) merge pattern, so T032 follows the identical planning route. ADR-002 and ADR-010 are not reopened; their constraints (two-layer storage, raw envelope vs normalized identity / content hash, capability-driven A+B routing, non-secret application User-Agent, single combined topic0 OR + topic1 poolId filter) are inlined as binding contract clauses. No code under src/ was touched, and todo/config.yaml's workflow_state, T032 attempt, base_commit, candidate_commit, latest_review, and agent_runtime block were left unchanged.
